about: Dental hygienist licensing facts by state. Each fact was read from the official pages listed under sources on the date in checked. A null value means it has not been confirmed yet. Nothing here has been checked by a qualified reviewer.

first_license.education: Diploma from an accredited dental hygiene program.
first_license.clinical_exam: A clinical exam score report is required if you studied out of state or graduated more than three years ago. WREB, CRDTS and ADEX reports are accepted.
first_license.law_exam: California Law and Ethics examination, taken after the board approves your application.
other_requirements: Fingerprints (Live Scan or hard card). A license is not issued until the background review is complete.
Out-of-state graduates need board-approved training in soft tissue curettage, local anesthesia and nitrous oxide-oxygen analgesia if not already completed.

renewal.period: Every two years, by the last day of your birth month.

continuing_education.hours: 25 units each two-year renewal, including the required courses.
required_topics: A two-unit California Dental Practice Act course.
A two-unit infection control course.
Basic Life Support (up to four units). Fully online courses are not accepted.
continuing_education.first_renewal: No continuing education units are required for the first renewal period.

first_license.education: Graduation from a dental hygiene program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation (CODA).
first_license.clinical_exam: One of: Commission on Dental Competency Assessments, Council of Interstate Testing Agencies, Southern Regional Testing Agency, Central Regional Dental Testing Service, or Western Regional Examining Board.

continuing_education.hours: At least 16 hours in the preceding 24 months.
required_topics: At least one hour on infection control in a dental setting.
One contact hour on cultural competency.

first_license.education: Graduation from a dental hygiene program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation. Applicants must be at least 18.
first_license.clinical_exam: ADEX Dental Hygiene Licensing Examination (scores are valid if taken on or after June 1, 2010).
first_license.fee: $130.00 in total: $50.00 application fee and $80.00 license fee.

renewal.period: Every two years. Licenses expire on February 28 of even-numbered years.

continuing_education.hours: 24 hours every two years: 22 general hours plus 2 hours on medical errors.
required_topics: 2 hours on preventing medical errors.
2 hours on domestic violence every third renewal, in addition to the 24 hours.
Current CPR certification from a live course.
continuing_education.first_renewal: For the first renewal, only 2 hours on HIV/AIDS are required.

first_license.education: An associate's degree from a dental hygiene school accredited by CODA or a recognized regional accrediting agency.
first_license.clinical_exam: A clinical exam from one of ADEX, CDCA, CRDTS, CITA, SRTA or WREB.
other_requirements: 3 hours of board-approved child abuse recognition and reporting training before a first license.

renewal.period: Every two years. The current period runs April 1, 2025 to March 31, 2027.

required_topics: 2 hours of board-approved child abuse recognition and reporting.

first_license.education: Graduate of a CODA-accredited dental hygiene program.
first_license.clinical_exam: ADEX or CRDTS-SRTA.

renewal.period: Every two years. A license expires two years from the date it was issued.
renewal.fee: $144.00 ($134.00 plus $10.00 for the dental hygienist loan repayment fund).

continuing_education.hours: At least 20 hours each registration period.
required_topics: Proof of Basic Life Support certification.
continuing_education.first_renewal: Recent graduates are exempt during their first two-year period.

first_license.education: Graduate of a dental hygiene program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation.
first_license.clinical_exam: A clinical exam from WREB, CRDTS, CDCA or the Council of Interstate Testing Agencies.
first_license.law_exam: Washington State Drug and Law Jurisprudence Examination.
other_requirements: A background check is processed for every applicant.

required_topics: A current Basic Life Support card.
A one-time three-hour suicide prevention course, which counts toward the 15 hours.

board.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Dentistry

first_license.education: Proof of graduation (official transcript or a signed letter from the school).
first_license.national_exam: National Board examination, with a passing score on all sections.
first_license.clinical_exam: A board-approved regional or state clinical exam.
first_license.law_exam: Massachusetts Dental Ethics and Jurisprudence Exam.
other_requirements: Current CPR/AED or Basic Life Support certification.
Criminal record (CORI) form, signed in person.
Two signatures from licensed dentists or dental hygienists.

continuing_education.hours: At least 20 units each two-year cycle, completed by March 31 in odd-numbered years.
continuing_education.first_renewal: New graduates of an accredited program are exempt for the licensing period in which they graduate.

board.name: Delaware Board of Dentistry and Dental Hygiene

first_license.clinical_exam: Delaware Practical Board Examination, given by the board in January and May.
first_license.law_exam: Jurisprudence Examination (20 questions for dental hygienists, open book).
first_license.fee: $117 application fee, plus a $100 dental hygienist exam fee.

renewal.period: Every two years. Licenses expire on May 31 of even-numbered years.

required_topics: At least 2 hours on infection control.
A current CPR course.
continuing_education.first_renewal: If this is your first renewal: licensed less than one year, no hours are required; licensed between one and two years, half the hours.

board.name: Michigan Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs

first_license.education: Graduation from a CODA-accredited dental hygiene program.
first_license.clinical_exam: All parts of the ADEX examination. Other clinical exams are not accepted.
other_requirements: CPR, BLS or ACLS certification with a hands-on part, earned within the two years before the license.
At least 2 hours of implicit bias training in the previous five years.

required_topics: At least 12 hours on clinical issues.
2 hours on pain and symptom management.
1 hour on dental ethics and jurisprudence.
1 hour on infection control.
At least 12 hours must be live.
1 hour of implicit bias training for each year of the license cycle.

notes: From the state's Dental Hygienist Licensing Guide, revision date January 26, 2026.

first_license.education: An associate degree in dental hygiene from an accredited school.
first_license.national_exam: National Board examination, with passing scores in all sections.
first_license.clinical_exam: All parts of one clinical exam (CDCA/NERB/WREB/CITA, CRDTS or SRTA), passed less than five years ago.
first_license.law_exam: Indiana jurisprudence exam: 30 questions, 75% to pass.

renewal.period: Every two years. Licenses expire on March 1 of even-numbered years.

continuing_education.hours: 19 hours each renewal period, at least half from live presentations or workshops.
required_topics: A basic life support course (only 2 hours count toward the total).
A 2-hour course on ethics, professional responsibility and Indiana statutes and rules.

first_license.education: Graduation from a dental hygiene degree program approved by the Commission on Dental Accreditation.
first_license.clinical_exam: The ADEX or CRDTS clinical hygiene examination, passed within the last five years.
first_license.law_exam: The board's jurisprudence exam, with a score of 80% or above.
first_license.fee: $125 if you apply in the first year of the two-year license period, or $75 in the second year.

renewal.period: Every two years. Licenses expire on December 31 of every even-numbered year.

continuing_education.hours: 30 hours every two-year cycle. At least 10 hours must be live and at least 20 must focus on clinical skills and knowledge.
required_topics: CPR does not count toward the 30 hours.
continuing_education.first_renewal: If you were licensed in the renewal year, no extra hours are needed. If you were licensed in the non-renewal year, 15 hours are needed before renewal.

board.name: Board of Dental Examiners of Alabama

first_license.education: A CODA-approved dental hygiene program or the Alabama Dental Hygiene Program.
first_license.clinical_exam: A regional exam passed within the last five years: CDCA, CITA, CRDTS, SRTA or WREB.
first_license.law_exam: An online jurisprudence test after your application is approved.

continuing_education.hours: 12 units for each 12 months of the renewal cycle.
required_topics: At least one unit each cycle in ethics.
At least one unit each cycle in infectious disease control.
Current Basic Life Support certification.

notes: Continuing education rules effective October 15, 2026. Fee schedule revised October 2026.

board.name: Texas State Board of Dental Examiners

first_license.education: Graduation from a CODA-accredited program, shown by an official transcript.
first_license.clinical_exam: A regional clinical exam with written and clinical parts, taken within the last seven years. The board currently validates scores from ADEX and CRDTS-SRTA.
first_license.law_exam: TSBDE Jurisprudence Assessment, completed within one year before you apply.
other_requirements: Current Basic Life Support CPR certification with a hands-on skills demonstration.
A National Practitioner Data Bank self-query.
Verification of every professional license you have held.

continuing_education.hours: 24 hours every two years, starting after your first renewal. At least 16 hours must be technical or scientific.
required_topics: An approved human trafficking prevention course, as part of the 24 hours.
The jurisprudence assessment every four years, in addition to the 24 hours.

board.name: New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions

first_license.education: A high school diploma or equivalent, plus a New York registered or CODA-accredited dental hygiene program. Applicants must be at least 17.
first_license.clinical_exam: The CDCA (ADEX) clinical dental hygiene examination.
other_requirements: Child abuse identification and reporting training.
Infection control and barrier precautions training.
first_license.fee: $128 for the license and first registration.

continuing_education.hours: 24 contact hours in each three-year registration period.

first_license.education: An A.S., B.A. or B.S. degree from an accredited school. Graduates of non-accredited schools are not eligible.
first_license.clinical_exam: A clinical licensure examination with a score of 75 or higher in all sections.
first_license.law_exam: Georgia jurisprudence exam: open book, 75 or higher, valid for one year.
other_requirements: A National Practitioner Data Bank self-query dated within four months.

renewal.period: Every two years. Licenses expire on December 31 of odd-numbered years.

required_topics: 15 of the hours must be in clinical science.

board.name: North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners

first_license.clinical_exam: Only the ADEX Dental Hygiene exam (passed after November 21, 2015) or the CITA Dental Hygiene exam (passed within the last five years).
first_license.law_exam: Online exams in infection control and sterilization, and in North Carolina jurisprudence.
other_requirements: Background check, with fingerprinting for North Carolina residents.

renewal.period: Every year, by January 1. Licenses not renewed by March 31 become void.

first_license.clinical_exam: One of the regional clinical exams.

continuing_education.hours: At least 15 hours for each annual renewal.
required_topics: A current hands-on CPR course for health care providers.
Four hours every two years on monitoring sedation, if you monitor patients under sedation or general anesthesia.

board.name: Arizona State Board of Dental Examiners

first_license.education: Graduate of an accredited dental hygiene school.
first_license.clinical_exam: A board-approved clinical examination passed within the last five years.
first_license.fee: $55 for the license through your first renewal date, plus $100 for the jurisprudence examination.

renewal.period: Every third year, by the end of your birth month.

first_license.clinical_exam: SRTA, WREB, CRDTS, CDCA (ADEX) or CITA (ADEX).
first_license.law_exam: A jurisprudence exam, for first licensure and at every renewal.

renewal.period: Every two years. Licenses expire on the last day of your birth month.

continuing_education.hours: 30 hours each two-year cycle. No more than half may be online.
required_topics: 2 of the 30 hours on chemical dependency.
A current CPR card at all times.

first_license.education: Graduate of a dental hygiene program approved by the Commission on Dental Accreditation.
first_license.clinical_exam: A state or regional clinical examination.
first_license.law_exam: SC Jurisprudence Examination, with a score of 70 or higher.
other_requirements: Letters of reference, at least one from a dentist.
A National Practitioner Data Bank self-query report.
